notes.title: Guidelines for Secondary Productions and Video Distribution
notes.content:
Secondary works and doujinshi related to [bisque doll with hoop removed] are permitted as long as they do not damage the image of the work or offend public order and morals!
We also permit the production of goods.
However, please keep it all within the scope of personal use.

We also permit the distribution of videos of the actual play.
There is no scope of what is not allowed in the story, but we would appreciate it if you put the URL of the store page in the summary section or encourage people to purchase the game if you are playing the game!

*All criteria such as “damaging the image of the work” and “within the scope of personal use” are at the discretion of Fear Institute Hatred.
